sources.title: Sources
sources.lead: Every statement carries its publisher and date. Quotes are capped at {max} characters.
sources.empty: No source is on file for this piece.

profile.methodologyNote: One number per brand — the same one the brand check uses, with the method in the open.
profile.correctionNote: We review every suggestion and answer with a reason. Removal on request is granted without discussion.
profile.removedNote: This brand asked to be removed. We keep the date and the reason on file.
profile.noSecondScore: For a brand we do not own there is only the website score — a foundation maturity is never invented.

ranking.frozen: Frozen. A refresh appears as a new issue — this one stays.
ranking.removedNote: The place stays empty; the list is not renumbered.
ranking.ctaTitle: Should your brand be on this list?

radar.title: Topic radar
radar.lead: What runs on a curated set of channels — a signal for the desk, never content to rewrite.
radar.retention: API numbers live at most {days} days, or they are fetched again every day.
radar.noComments: No comment texts, no user names. The comment count is a public metric of the video.
radar.formula: Normalised to 100: the average of the signals we have (0–20 each), computed from {count} of {total} signals. Three of them work today: performance (views ÷ subscribers), age (half-life 90 days) and relevance (closeness to our topics). Search demand and competition are missing as long as there is no data source for them.
radar.empty: No run yet. The radar needs an API key.

editor.title: Desk
editor.lead: AI drafts, the desk edits and publishes. Nothing goes public without that signature.
editor.baseLocaleNote: The base version is the edited one. The second language grows out of it.
editor.translated: Translation is on file as a draft
editor.evidenceOk: Quote appears verbatim in the source
editor.evidenceFail: Quote not found in the source
editor.rulesBlocked: {count} open points — moving to the desk is blocked.
editor.readingMinutes: Reading time {count} min — computed on save.
